title: POST /projects/create golden characterization

characterized_route.notes: Largest remaining inline route. Uses FastAPI Form(...) injection (NOT await request.form()). Creates ProjectRecord + WorkspaceState (no scenario created explicitly). 18 form fields with defaults. Project code uniqueness loop. Template source validation (wind/solar).

auth: Unauth -> 302 redirect to /login (NOT 401 JSON, NOT HX-Redirect)
form_inputs: Uses FastAPI Form(...) injection (NOT await request.form())

18 form fields: project_name, project_type, template_source, country_market, capacity_mw, cod_date, construction_months, horizon_years, tariff_eur_mwh, ppa_term_years, p50_hours, opex_y1_keur, total_capex_keur, gearing_pct, interest_rate_pct, tenor_years, target_dscr
default_scenario_workspace: Does NOT call add_scenario(...) or save_scenario(...)
project_type_template: Wind templates require Wind project type
Solar templates require Solar project type

intended_side_effects.ordering: auth -> _submitted_new_project_defaults + form values -> _coerce_form_text -> _canonical_project_type -> _normalize_template_source -> _validate_new_project_payload -> template validation -> [loop] get_project_by_code -> _project_baseline_snapshot -> _apply_new_project_required_inputs -> create_project_record -> save_workspace_state -> TemplateResponse

quirks_pinned: 1. Uses FastAPI Form(...) parameters, NOT await request.form() or _collect_form_snapshot
3. Partial template render (partials/new_project_result.html), NOT full workspace render
4. Project code uniqueness loop with -2, -3, ... suffixes
6. Template source validation: wind templates require Wind type, solar templates require Solar type
8. project_origin='user_created' only; no gate for non-user_created
9. Does NOT explicitly call add_scenario or save_scenario; only creates ProjectRecord + WorkspaceState
